# Terrapin Logo Program Library fixtures

These `.lgo` files are the programs published in the Terrapin Logo Program
Library (https://resources.terrapinlogo.com/logolib/), copied verbatim from
the `<pre>` blocks of each program page (`biosphere_2.lgo` is the second listing
on the Biosphere page). They are used by `tests/logolib.test.ts` as a parity
suite: every program must load and run without an interpreter error.

Copyright of the programs remains with Terrapin / their contributors; they are
included here solely as test fixtures for Logo dialect compatibility.
